llm.summary: The skill appears to implement a WorthClip YouTube scoring integration, but metadata inconsistencies and a mismatch between the claimed homepage (worthclip.com) and the API base domain (greedy-mallard-11.convex.site) warrant caution before installing or granting an API key.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name, description, scripts, and SKILL.md all indicate a YouTube-scoring integration that needs a WORTHCLIP_API_KEY and uses curl/jq — that is coherent with the stated purpose. However, the declared API Base URL (greedy-mallard-11.convex.site) does not match the public homepage (worthclip.com), which is unusual and should be verified.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to calling the API (score, feed, usage, etc.) via the included bash scripts and instruct the user to set an API key. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading unrelated system files or collecting unrelated secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), so nothing will be automatically downloaded or written to disk beyond the provided scripts. This is lower risk than arbitrary remote installs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md metadata and the skill's header clearly require WORTHCLIP_API_KEY and list curl/jq, which is appropriate. But the registry metadata shown earlier lists 'Required env vars: none' — an inconsistency. The skill does not ask for unrelated credentials, but the mismatch in declared requirements should be resolved before trusting the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not set always:true and has disable-model-invocation:true, so it cannot be autonomously invoked by the model and will not be force-included in all agent runs. This reduces the blast radius of any credential misuse.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, inspect the three bash scripts (scripts/score.sh, scripts/feed.sh, scripts/usage.sh) to confirm where they send data and ensure your API key will only be used by WorthClip. Verify the API base URL: confirm that greedy-mallard-11.convex.site is an official WorthClip endpoint (or a documented proxy) — if not, do not use your production API key. Resolve the registry metadata mismatch (it should declare WORTHCLIP_API_KEY). If unsure, request clarification from the publisher or run the scripts in an isolated environment with a limited/test API key first.
